title: Identification of factors associated with failure to meet nocturnal penile tumescence and rigidity criteria based on RigiScan monitoring and machine learning algorithms: a cross-sectional study
summary: Among 519 men with erectile dysfunction, internal validation of five models found logistic regression best for nocturnal erection criteria (AUC 0.779, 95% CI 0.692–0.861); metabolic and demographic factors were predictive, while tree/boosting models performed worse. This is a limited retrospective diagnostic-classification result. The publisher lists 2026/10/27; the first version reporting this result is dated 2026-10-27.
ai_technology: LR, RF, SVM, LightGBM and XGBoost classify RigiScan efficacy using nocturnal physiology and clinical features.
organization: Department of Andrology, Yangzhou Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, China; Department of General Surgery, Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine/Jiangsu Province Hospital of Chinese Medicine, China; Department of Respiratory Medicine, Sichuan First Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, China

evidence.tested: Among 519 men with erectile dysfunction, internal validation of five models found logistic regression best for nocturnal erection criteria (AUC 0.779, 95% CI 0.692–0.861); metabolic and demographic factors were predictive, while tree/boosting models performed worse. This is a bounded retrospective diagnostic-classification result. Patient-level 70/30 split and nested CV; threshold fixed on training data; the best model was LR and single-center external validation is absent.
